Creed|Ursarkar E. Creed]], who was the Lord General of the Astra Militarum and Lord Castellan of Cadia during the Thirteenth Black Crusade ** [[wh40k:Ursula J. Creed|Ursula J. Creed]], the daughter of Ursarkar E. Creed, and the current Lord Castellan of the surviving Cadian Shock Troopers * The player title, "Still Standing", is a reference to "Cadia Stands". The phrase came to be during a speech by Ursarkar E. Creed, where his mic cut off and all the gathered Cadians heard was "Cadia Stands"[https://www.reddit.com/r/40kLore/comments/18554v8/the_fall_of_cadia_excerpt_the_origins_of_cadia/ The Origins of "Cadia Stands", and how it was misheard]. After the [[wh40k:Cadia#Destruction|fall of Cadia]], this phrase became a common battle cry/cheer used by surviving Cadian Guardsman, and a way to honour their homeworld. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.007.000|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.204|date=2026-05-21|changes= Announced[https://steamcommunity.com/games/553850/announcements/detail/714533682400987751 HELLDIVERS™ 2 | Steam] }} ==References== [[Category:Warbonds]] {{Nav Warbond}}

These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 110). Players start on [[#Page 1|page one]], unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options. ==Contents== Different types of [[weapons]] than in previous Warbonds—namely, two stratagems and a supportive [[Weapons#Special-2|secondary]]—with no [[booster]]. *[[TX-41 Sterilizer|Sterilizer]] sprays caustic [[Damage#Damage Types|gas]] while holding '''Righteous Revenants''' is a [[Legendary Warbond]] featuring the [[Helldivers x Killzone|second version]] of the ''[[Helldivers 2]]'' × ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Killzone Killzone]'' crossover, available for {{Currency|Super Credits|1,500}} in the [[Acquisition Center]]. ==Overview== Players can use [[Medals]] to claim various items, including 3 [[weapons]], 2 [[armor]]s, and 9 [[cosmetics]]. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 75). Players start on [[#Page 1|page one]], unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options. '''Truth Enforcers''' is a [[Warbonds#Premium|Premium Warbond]] available for {{Currency|Super Credits|1,000}} in the Warbonds tab of the [[Acquisition Center]]. ==Overview== Players can use [[Medals]] to claim various items, including a [[booster]], 3 [[weapons]], 2 [[armor]]s, 6 [[cosmetics]], and 300 Super Credits. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 7 to 65). Players start on [[#Page 1|page one]], unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options. ==Contents== *The [[SG-20 Halt]] is similar to the [[SG-8 Punisher]], but can alternate between stun rounds and armor-penetrating flechettes. *The [[SMG-32 Reprimand]] is a two-handed [[Weapons#Submachine Gun-0|SMG]], capable of firing medium armor-penetrating rounds. *The [[PLAS-15 Loyalist]] is a semi-auto plasma pistol that can be charged to deal more damage, similar to the [[PLAS-101 Purifier]]. *[[Unflinching]] ([[Armor Passives#Unflinching|armor passive]]) reduces staggering when hit, in addition to increasing armor rating by 25 and providing marker radar scans. *[[Dead Sprint]] (booster) allows [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] to continue running with depleted stamina, at the cost of draining their health. ===Page 1===
